input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer, which is the preferred position. Clause 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer is free to engage any supplier and has made no exclusivity, non-compete or minimum-volume commitment, and clause 2.1 confirms no minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies and that declining further Order Forms is not a breach. The only exclusivity-flavoured restraint runs against Vendor (12.4, non-compete with Customer's analytics products), which benefits us and is not flagged. Searches for "exclusive"/"sole" language returned only unrelated uses (non-exclusive licence, exclusive jurisdiction, exclusive remedy).
